programme.title: Roadtrip With G. Garvin - Atlanta
programme.desc: S2E1 - G. Garvin heads back to his hometown of Atlanta; shrimp and grits; red velvet cake; fried chicken. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Roadtrip With G. Garvin - Louisville
programme.desc: S2E6 - A visit to 610 Magnolia in Louisville, Ky., for slow-cooked oxtails; Hammerheads' eclectic menu; Juanita's Burger Boy Diner, serves classic diner fare; The Rudyard Kipling, known for burgoo, a meat and veggie stew. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Eatin' OK in the OKC
programme.desc: S5E12 - Ali Khan's day of deliciousness starts with tiramisu pancakes; an authentic, crispy Cuban sandwich. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Eating Vermont
programme.desc: S3E13 - Ali kicks things off in Burlington, VT, with a local favorite, the unique bacon maple wafflini; he hits up a lunch counter that's been around since the 1940s; Ali tries the Macho Man, a sandwich that mashes together a Reuben and patty melt. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Queen City Cravings
programme.desc: S5E5 - Sweet and satisfying slowberry cobbler waffle; a food truck that's serving up mouthwatering sliders that are too good to try only one; a decadent French Pot de Crème; ramen gumbo that's packed with a fusion of flavor. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Cream of the Crop
programme.desc: S2E9 - Ali begins his day in Louisville, Ky., by cutting into a towering stack of hot chocolate pancakes; a saucy Mata Hari hot brown; apple brandied pie; Southern fried chicken and sweet potato waffles. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Santa Barbara Bargains
programme.desc: S4E10 - Ali Khan is in Santa Barbara, Calif. Looking for the best deals for breakfast, lunch, dinner and a snack; he gets off to a pricey start with a bacon and egg breakfast sandwich on a buttery brioche that's worth every penny. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Mealin' and Dealin' in Michigan
programme.desc: S5E3 - Ali Khan chows down in Ann Arbor, Mich., starting with a heaping helping of deep-fried French toast covered in berries and whipped cream; blackened mackerel with a Thai chili glaze at a super fresh seafood market. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Decadent Regional Dishes
programme.desc: S2E6 - In Baton Rouge, La., chef Jay Ducote introduces a French and Cajun-inspired burger; in St. Louis, toasted ravioli stuffed with burnt ends; in Austin, Texas, a gigantic peach-glazed pork chop and peanut butter mousse pie. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Super Chefs' Favorite Foods
programme.desc: S2E8 - Football legend, Earl Campbell, digs into brisket and peach cobbler at one of Texas' most famous barbecue restaurants; in Cincinnati, a bacon and blue cheeseburger; in Kansas City, Mo., inside-out shepherd's pie and beer-infused doughnuts. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Juicy, Crunchy and Tangy
programme.desc: S2E9 - In Lexington, Ky., a plump pork burger and smoked chicken wings; spicy fried chicken and waffles that are making the Cincinnati food scene soar; Caribbean-inspired rum-soaked ribs in New Orleans. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Motor City's Mouthwatering Meats
programme.desc: S3E5 - Michael takes reality television star Kendra Wilkinson on a whirlwind food and beer tour of Detroit to introduce her to one of the country's most resurgent cities; enjoys microbrews, Coney Island dogs, spicy Korean sliders and pulled pork enchiladas. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Decadent D.C. Dining
programme.desc: S3E7 - Michael Symon and the winner of "Worst Cooks in America: Celebrity Edition," Jenni "JWoww" Farley, team up to tackle classic barbecue, fresh farmhouse burgers and microbrews; one of the area's best-known chefs gives his take on the local cuisine. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Smoking Meats and Summertime Eats
programme.desc: S4E7 - A whole pig on a super-sized indoor smoke pit; slow-smoked rib-eye steak sandwich complete with melted cheddar and caramelized onions; double beef patty burger that gets the royal treatment with two bacon grilled cheese sandwiches for buns. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Kyoto

In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. programme.desc: After a failed attempt to recover a stolen baby panda, police dog Max reluctantly teams up with a human FBI agent named Frank. A hot tip leads Max and Frank to Las Vegas for the world's most exclusive dog show. To find the panda, Max goes undercover as a contestant to get the lowdown from his fellow canines. With help from their new friends, the crime-fighting duo must now foil another kidnapping plot and rescue other valuable animals from a gang of greedy smugglers. - Will Arnett, Natasha Lyonne, RuPaul, Omar Chaparro, Andy Beckwith (Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick. - Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger, Mary-Louise Parker, David Strathairn, Joan Plowright (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Drama, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Wolf Kahler, Ronald Lacey (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott, Alison Doody, John Rhys-Davies (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Family, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. - Harrison Ford, Julia Ormond, Greg Kinnear, Nancy Marchand, John Wood (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. - Patrick Swayze, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Joseph Mazzello, Seth Mumy, David Marshall Grant (Fantasy)

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: In the 23rd century, the Starship Enterprise is dispatched to the scene of a giant energy field about to engulf two ships. Capt. Kirk (William Shatner) averts calamity, but is exposed to the field and presumed dead. Years later, the Enterprise's new commander, Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart), learns that one of the disaster's survivors, Dr. Soran (Malcolm McDowell), plans to enter the field by destroying a neighboring star. Picard now must collaborate with an unlikely ally in order to stop him. - Patrick Stewart, William Shatner, Malcolm McDowell, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin

She seeks a wealthy husband and, in trying to conform to social expectations, she misses her chance for real love with Lawrence Selden (Eric Stoltz). Her quest for a husband comes to a scandalous end when she is falsely accused of having an affair with a married man and is rejected by society and her friends. - Gillian Anderson, Eric Stoltz, Dan Aykroyd, Eleanor Bron, Terry Kinney (Historical drama)

Eventually, he falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married. - Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore, Christine Taylor, Allen Covert, Matthew Glave (Romantic comedy)

But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: David Jeremiah
programme.desc: In this weekly program, Dr. David Jeremiah delivers practical messages to the congregation at the Shadow Mountain Community Church in San Diego. Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming. (Religious)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - If the Pawn Don't Fit
programme.desc: S14E28 - After test-driving the infamous O.J. Simpson Bronco, Rick must decide whether to purchase this million-dollar item; a rare silverware set; a 1978 "Star Wars" comic. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Three Ring Pawn
programme.desc: S23E9 - When a seller brings in a signed Righteous Brothers record, will it leave Rick and Corey with that lovin' feeling? Then, will Chum be ready to jump through hoops when checking out a pull-apart circus toy from the 1920s? Or will it take too many acrobatics to land a deal? Later, Rick fine-tunes an offer for a 1950s Gretsch guitar. Will he make an amped-up deal, or will he and the seller be out of tune? And finally, Chum is locked and loaded when he checks out a Palmer rifle from the Civil War. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Citizen Pawn
programme.desc: S24E5 - Rick hopes for a slam dunk when he checks out a pair of sneakers owned by NBA superstar Shaquille O' Neal; will the deal be a shoe in, or will the seller cry foul? Then, a pair of rare coins come into the shop; will Corey want to cash in, or will he sleep on the deal?; Chum is firing on all cylinders for what a seller believes is a Parrot cannon from the Civil War; finally, a seller comes in with a set of golf clubs used by President Eisenhower. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Raking in the Dough
programme.desc: S24E6 - When a seller brings in a life-sized E.T. statue, Rick tries to make an out of this world deal. Will he dial up a great offer, or will he need to phone home for something better? Then, Corey takes a shot at a book about John Wilkes Booth. But can he pull the trigger, or will the deal be eradicated? Later, Rick tries to stay afloat when he checks out a unique Romain Jerome watch. And finally, Corey and Chum try to rake in the dough when they take a look at an antique breadbox. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Rick's Roulette
programme.desc: S11E28 - Rick auctions off some of the shop's coolest finds; Corey and Chum check out an Ultra 4 Racecar; Rick sees one of the biggest collections of Mickey Mouse memorabilia in the world. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - La La Land
programme.desc: S14E11 - Rick heads to Los Angeles for a shopping spree; he views props from the movie, "Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory" and a painting by actor Leonardo DiCaprio; Chumlee considers a helicopter owned by Las Vegas magician Dirk Arthur. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - The Smoking Gun
programme.desc: S11E7 - A Brown Bess musket comes into the shop; Thomas Jefferson's private copy of Jay's Treaty; a smashed guitar from KISS frontman Paul Stanley comes by. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Samurai, Stones and Skateboards
programme.desc: S20E12 - A seller brings in a blazer worn by the Rolling Stones' Keith Richards; a Japanese samurai mask hits the counter; a Norman Rockwell autograph comes into the shop. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Dream Pawn
programme.desc: S22E4 - Unboxing a skateboard signed by Carrie Fisher; Corey has a first-person encounter with "Halo: Combat Evolved"; a colorful vintage Versace collection stuns Chum; a seller brings in a guitar signed by Aerosmith's Joe Perry. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Rick's Gone With the Wind
programme.desc: S18E2 - Chumlee gets ready to rumble when a rare wrestling figure comes into the shop; a portable craps table is smuggled in; Rick checks out a vintage Eclipse windmill. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - No More Mr. Nice Buys
programme.desc: S23E4 - When an outfit supposedly worn by Alice Cooper hits the counter, it'll be No More Mr. Nice Guy as Rick tries to land a deal; Chum gets mercenary when he makes an offer on a 7-foot tall Deadpool PEZ dispenser. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - No Sleep Til Vegas
programme.desc: S19E10 - When a seller sends in the original cover art for one of the greatest albums of all time, Rick fights for his right to buy it; some big money bills signed by billionaires Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger make their way across the counter. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Rick's Big Check
programme.desc: S20E8 - The shop travels back in time when a map from the late 1800s comes in; Corey spots a killer Mustang for sale; Rick takes a ride to check out a collection of transistor radios; Chum and Rick get their hands on Magic: The Gathering prototype cards. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - The Champ Pays a Call
programme.desc: S23E10 - Chum gets a taste of a Julia Child cookbook; Rick kickflips for a vintage skateboard collection; Corey tries to score a Steph Curry jersey; Rick comes out swinging for a punching bag signed by an Academy Award-winning actor. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Everything From Pawn to Nuts
programme.desc: S23E5 - A seller comes into the shop with some chef whites signed by the actor who played the Soup Nazi on "Seinfeld"; Corey tries to make a surreally good deal on a Dali lithograph from a collaboration with Walt Disney. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Ship Happens
programme.desc: S17E10 - Rick heads to Boston to check out an iconic warship; a Paul McCartney-signed guitar; a curious corkscrew collection; Rick gets a lead on an Apple 1, and he has to decide if he wants a byte. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - A Loose Cannon
programme.desc: S17E27 - Chum meets a seller with a giant collection of figurines from "The Simpsons"; Corey checks out an old playing card shuffler; a seller shows off his original copy of "Ben Hur"; Rick and Corey check out a mountain cannon. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: The UnXplained - The Power of Gold
programme.desc: S2E12 - As one of the most valuable and coveted precious metals on the planet, gold's power over mankind harkens back thousands of years. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Mysterious Urban Legends
programme.desc: S7E12 - From the eerie reports of spontaneous human combustion and the hunt for the Highgate Vampire, to the unsettling boogeymen known as the Men in Black appearing after UFO sightings, could these legends be more than just stories? (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Superhuman Feats
programme.desc: S4E9 - Whether surviving freezing temperatures, diving unfathomable depths in one breath, or lifting weighty objects, superhuman feats never cease to amaze; pulling them off could be a matter of training, willpower, genetics, or something more mysterious. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - The Oak Island Curse
programme.desc: S1E9 - For more than 200 years, treasure hunters have been coming to Oak Island in search of a treasure that has so far eluded them all, and has even cost six men their lives, could it be, as legend suggests, the treasure is protected by a deadly curse. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Tales From Antarctica
programme.desc: S7E7 - Isolated along the southernmost part of the planet, Antarctica is best known as the frozen continent. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - America's Lost Treasures
programme.desc: S4E17 - Whether legends of vast, lost treasures hidden throughout the U.S. are real or tall tales. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Strange Tales From the American Frontier
programme.desc: S7E14 - Bizarre, mysterious tales ran rampant and are still being told to this day; are these strange tales of the American frontier simply legend, or was the west far stranger than one could possibly imagine? (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Bizarre Rituals
programme.desc: S1E5 - Ancient practices such as prayer, blood sports, voodoo and exorcism are often thought to be relics of bygone superstition, but there is evidence they have an impact on the physical world. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Secrets of Ancient Structures
programme.desc: S6E3 - Age-old mysterious ruins stand as silent sentinels from the past, with their true history seemingly erased by time; modern archaeology attempts to unravel the enigma of how and why the ancient structures were built. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Acts of God
programme.desc: S4E5 - Examining various events that are said to have been directed by the hand of the Almighty, such as the Great Flood, the Plagues of Egypt, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Moses parting the Red Sea. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - The Weird Wild West
programme.desc: S4E20 - The American frontier is full of legends of cowboys, Native Americans and outlaws; but there are also many eerie stories of cursed mountains, monsters and even UFOs. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo - Lost in Battle
programme.desc: S2E15 - From a live WWII bomb discovered decades later, to a Civil War cigar hiding secret orders, to a Viking sword unearthed by a child, these finds reveal how the remnants of war can resurface when least expected. (History, Mystery, Travel)

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo - Found Fortunes
programme.desc: S2E9 - The world's greatest fortunes often surface in the most unlikely places; from a Fabergé egg found at a humble flea market, to rare baseball cards hidden inside an old piano, or even a backyard sapphire worth a king's ransom; these treasures prove that sometimes one person's forgotten clutter can become another's once-in-a-lifetime discovery. (History, Mystery, Travel)

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo - Beastly Revelations
programme.desc: S1E7 - From a mythical monster that turns out to be real, to a deadly prehistoric animal, and a frozen tundra hiding a pandora's box full of lethal pathogens, these startling discoveries shock and terrify the world. (History, Mystery, Travel)

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo - Mysterious Structures
programme.desc: S1E1 - A Revolutionary War era ship hides under the streets of Manhattan; a sprawling Roman villa is unearthed in the backyard of an English home; finding an ancient Grecian maze that is long thought to be a myth. (History, Mystery, Travel)

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo - Wild Discoveries
programme.desc: S2E14 - A species thought lost forever is spotted again; a dog plays an unexpected role in recovering the World Cup trophy; a puppy from the Ice Age emerges intact after 18,000 years; revealing just how unpredictable the natural world can be.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo - Sacred Discoveries

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Unusual Rituals
programme.desc: S1E7 - Human bones as a "miracle cure" for gout; living mummies buried alive; a truly bizarre Victorian way to lose weight -- with tapeworms; from daily rites to once-in-a-lifetime rituals, the stranger side of human nature is revealed in these rituals.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Shocking Missions
programme.desc: S3E3 - History is full of legendary missions, but some are so bizarre, they sound like fiction; from a covert op involving toilet paper, to a war sparked by a single tree, to a pilot who turned the skies into a candy drop zone.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Strange Sightings
programme.desc: S3E1 - From stone-throwing jungle apes, to swarms of sinister clowns stalking the suburbs, to skies raining down murderous birds, these are the strange encounters that leave the experts scratching their heads.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Strange Experiments
programme.desc: S1E8 - Monkey glands for immortality, hypnotized assassins and a brain-linked cyborg couple; investigating some of the strangest experiments on record.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Astonishing Bodies
programme.desc: S1E3 - From a headless chicken that lives over one year, to an out-of-this-world "celestial body" where it rains molten glass, the team explores the most astonishing bodies through these truly unbelievable stories.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: S1E9 - A look at tales of strange things below Earth's surface, including sea beasts, hidden cities, and tunnels carved by giant sloths.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Sweet Revenge
programme.desc: S2E2 - Studying stories of revenge, such as the one about a man in Colorado that uses a Killdozer to settle a zoning dispute or another about an emperor who pickles his wife's lover; exploring vengeance seekers who take things too far.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Surviving the Impossible
programme.desc: S1E10 - Imagining free-falling 30,000 feet without a parachute, or being buried alive and living to tell the tale; these are improbable yet true-life tales of surviving the most extraordinary conditions.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Bizarre Innovations
programme.desc: S2E6 - A fully functioning car that hovers in midair; clothing made out of calcium; a robot dog that breathes fire; discussing bizarre inventions.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Most Shocking Dances With Death
programme.desc: S3E20 - What drives someone to gamble with their own life? From a French tailor who leaps off the Eiffel Tower to a man struck by lightning more times than should be humanly possible, these perilous wagers with death are as shocking as they are unbelievable. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Epic Fails (New)
programme.desc: S4E1 - A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: Mysteries From Above - Unexpected Naturally (New)
programme.desc: S5E1 - Revealed from above; massive striped mounds forming beehive shapes and cones in the outback of Western Australia; high above the city of Huelva, Spain, the view from above reveals a way too neon pool of emerald green water; high above the shores of the Gulf of Riga in Latvia the view from above reveals an intricate collection of geometric shapes in the landscape; on the Hawaiian Island of Hawai'i, the view from above reveals kilometers of seemingly never-ending lush, green foliage. (Documentary)

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Outlandish Ideas
programme.desc: S3E6 - When the world throws a bizarre problem your way, sometimes the solution is even more ridiculous; from a coastal cleanup plan that ends with an earth-shaking surprise, to a fugitive's fiery fix for an unexpected problem, these are the real-life moments when people thought way outside the box. (Documentary, History, Anthology)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. - Bailey Chase, Neal McDonough, Dawn Olivieri (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path. - Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz, Susan Sarandon (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
programme.desc: The unusual genetic makeup of a librarian (Eric Bana) causes him to travel back and forth through time, so that he and his beloved (Rachel McAdams) are always out of sync. - Rachel McAdams, Eric Bana, Arliss Howard (Movies, Romance)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: An outrageous British woman (Renée Zellweger) decides to take control of her life, but instead falls for two very different men (Colin Firth, Hugh Grant). - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant (Movies, Romance)

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Fired from his teaching job for losing his cool, a disgruntled man (Ice Cube) challenges the colleague (Charlie Day) who snitched on him to a fight after school. - Charlie Day, Ice Cube, Tracy Morgan (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school. - Amanda Bynes, James Kirk, Channing Tatum (Movies, Romance)

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Two cops must confront their teenage angst all over again when they go undercover as high-school students. - Jonah Hill, Channing Tatum, Brie Larson (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Officers Jenko and Schmidt begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college. - Jonah Hill, Channing Tatum, Peter Stormare (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. - Elliot Page, Sam Keeley, Tom Vaughan-Lawlor (Movies, Horror)

programme.title: Afflicted
programme.desc: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely. - Clif Prowse, Derek Lee, Baya Rehaz (Movies, Horror)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: An old and mysterious camcorder leads to the discovery of a supernatural terror in a family's new home. - Chris J. Murray, Brit Shaw, Olivia Taylor Dudley (Movies, Horror)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.). - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher Jr (Movies, Thriller)

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: During the 1930s and '40s, wealthy industrialist Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) gains fame as a movie producer, airplane designer and pilot. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Cate Blanchett, Kate Beckinsale (Movies, History)

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: After 20 years away, Odysseus washes up on the shores of Ithaca. The king finds much has changed since he left to fight in the Trojan War. No longer the mighty warrior his people remember, Odysseus must face his past to save his family. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Charlie Plummer (Movies, History)

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. - Elisabeth Shue, Michael Byrne, Phillip Noyce (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, Takeshi Kitano (Movies, Sci-Fi)

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, must prevent the Man in Black (Matthew McConaughey) from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. - Idris Elba, Matthew McConaughey, Tom Taylor (Movies, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When a man claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams, arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. Morticia begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life. - Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults. - Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet, thought to be the key to saving the world, is accompanied by a fellowship of strangers embarking on a quest to vanquish a tyrant bent on a terrible deed. - Chris Pratt, Will Ferrell, Morgan Freeman (Movies, Animated)

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans. - Elisabeth Shue, Steven R McQueen, Adam Scott (Movies, Horror)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity. - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox (Movies, Horror)

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn baby home from the hospital. Realizing that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal experts and install numerous cameras to drive the spirit out. - Ashley Tisdale, Simon Rex, Erica Ash (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night. - Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat, Amber Armstrong (Movies, Horror)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: A young man and his traveling companions battle an array of monsters during an 80-mile journey to find the woman he loves. - Dylan O'Brien, Jessica Henwick, Dan Ewing (Movies, Fantasy)

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation. - Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ken Watanabe, Elizabeth Olsen (Movies, Sci-Fi)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden (Movies, War)

programme.title: Gone Baby Gone
programme.desc: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child. - Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan, Morgan Freeman (Movies, Mystery)

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin (Movies, History)

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives. - Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea (Movies, Action)

programme.desc: S5E11 - A Vermont family finally finds their dream spot on Lake Champlain. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Flip for the Family on Lake Guntersville, Alabama
programme.desc: S5E1 - After years of hard work, a real estate agent uses the fruits of her labor to purchase an investment property that can be flipped for dual purposes; a new home for her daughter that will one day transition into an excellent rental property. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Lakefront Fixer Upper Near Family
programme.desc: S5E7 - Wanting to be closer to the family, first-time homebuyers look for a place that won't break their budget and that's close to their favorite lakes; with houses selling for over a million dollars, they need a diamond in the rough to fix. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Living the Lake Life Dream on Lake Amon G. Carter, Texas
programme.desc: S5E12 - After years of visits to the lake, the family of five is ready to find a forever home on Lake Amon G. Carter; their dream is to build a home with unlimited activities for all and unmatched views of the lake from every angle. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - 10,000 Lakes, One Perfect Lake House

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Hoping for Major Upgrades for Minimal Cost on Lake Erie

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Texas Hillside Retreat

(House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Arkansas Mountain Cabin
programme.desc: S13E6 - A couple head to Arkansas with their kids to build a dream mountain getaway; while the views of this location are breathtaking, this build is anything but a breeze; the family has to work together through severe weather to get this job done. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Georgia Mountain Watchtower
programme.desc: S12E1 - A Georgia couple is ready to tackle their next off-grid build: the ultimate watchtower guest house in the Blue Ridge Mountains; building 30 feet off the ground presents its challenges. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Bottle Island
programme.desc: S3E1 - John Beal is ready to leave the city behind and embrace an off-the-grid life in Isla Mujeres, Mexico; Beal hires Richart Sowa and his son, Eden, to build an eco-friendly private floating island made from recycled plastic bottles. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Bamboo House
programme.desc: S8E1 - Bamboo-home architect David Sands seizes the opportunity to build his own getaway in Hawaii that features a luxurious outdoor bath area and detached, starlit master bedroom; however, volcanic eruptions threaten to send the entire project up in smoke. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Alabama Arch House
programme.desc: S11E5 - A young family in Alabama breaks ground on its forever home during peak hurricane season; between the delays from flooding, waiting for their building kit to arrive and falling glass, it will take everything they have to make this dream a reality. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Arizona Straw Bale Home
programme.desc: S13E3 - A couple plans to build their home out of straw bales in the Arizona desert in only six months; using Earthship architecture as their motivation, they hope to make this structure modern, durable and unique. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Utah Desert Cabin

programme.desc: S2E7 - The crew takes on a foursquare farmhouse in Roanoke, Va.; Mike works on a tailgater grill unit.

programme.title: Human vs Hamster - Trivia Kings and Volunteer Queens

programme.title: Fixer Upper: The Hotel - We're in the Hotel Business!
programme.desc: S1E1 - Chip and Joanna Gaines have big ideas for transforming an old brick building into a boutique hotel; before demolition begins, they must make tough design decisions for the guest rooms, while preserving historical architectural elements.

programme.title: Fixer Upper: The Hotel - When Modern Design and Historical Architecture Collide
programme.desc: S1E2 - Jo finalizes design for all four floors of the hotel, and Chip begins demo; they soon find that transforming century-old architecture into a 33-room boutique hotel brings unexpected challenges that require design pivots and an elevator.

programme.title: Fixer Upper: The Hotel - Creating Unique Spaces
programme.desc: S1E3 - Chip and Jo focus on the public spaces with distinctive design elements in the restaurant, lobby, library and group suite; Chip lands a rare find for the hotel library.

programme.title: Fixer Upper: The Hotel - A New Phase for the Hotel
programme.desc: S1E4 - Completed wallpaper and tile provide hints at the hotel's future grandeur as the project enters into its final stages of construction; Chip and Jo meet with the hotel's new general manager to discuss preparations for opening day.

programme.title: Fixer Upper: The Hotel - Styling and Preparing the Hotel for Grand Opening
programme.desc: S1E5 - With construction finished, it's go-time for Jo and the team to style all three floors, as well as the rooftop restaurant, with custom furniture and antique finds before opening day, but their progress is hindered by unexpected elevator issues.

programme.title: Fixer Upper: The Hotel - Checking in to Hotel 1928
programme.desc: S1E6 - Before opening to the public, Chip, Jo and Ben walk each floor of the finished renovation to reveal a stunning transformation of the once dilapidated historical building into the spectacular Hotel 1928, Chip and Jo's biggest project yet.

programme.title: Fixer Upper - Rebuilding After Tragedy

programme.title: Fixer Upper - Newlyweds Seek First Home.

programme.desc: S3E1 - A couple tours homes in Hillsboro, Texas, in hopes of finding a larger house to accommodate their three growing sons.

programme.title: Fixer Upper - Taking a Chance
programme.desc: S2E3 - A couple tours homes in the Dean Highland neighborhood of Waco, Texas, hoping to find a place with character.

programme.title: Fixer Upper - The Ultimate Bachelor Pad
programme.desc: S3E11 - A bachelor leaves New York to return to his roots in Waco, Texas, with proximity to Lake Waco.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Overhaul on the Upper Narrows
programme.desc: S9E8 - After a tree falls onto the roof of a family camp, the mishap is chosen as an opportunity; the "Maine Cabin Masters" are called in to facilitate an expansion.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Friend in Need
programme.desc: S9E16 - A man enlists the team to make his tiny cabin on the water more comfortable; he wants to restore a vintage sink and honor his late friend, who was an electrician; when a storm threatens the build at the end, the crew must find a way to finish safely.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Growing Gem on Pocasset
programme.desc: S9E11 - A growing family needs more space at their camp on Pocasset Lake; while the crew handles the remodeling, layout revamp, wall replacement and dormer addition, Ashley and Ryan come up with a way to display the family's tradition of collecting rocks. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Back to Mint Condition

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Legacy Camp on Maranacook Lake
programme.desc: S9E1 - A lake-loving family outgrows their legacy cabin; the gang tackles the challenges of remodeling the mazelike layout as Ashley uses an heirloom for a special project, all in time for the family's annual 4th of July party. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Campify This House!
programme.desc: S12E7 - The crew helps a couple turn their chopped up, suburban cabin into the spacious, rustic Maine getaway they've always wanted; with the help of some new faces and upgraded equipment, the Cabin Masters breathe new life into this family's retreat. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster of hosts, former players and inside information men. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: A young singing sensation prepares to dazzle the crowd at a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden. Legions of adoring Bieber fans scream as he takes center stage for a memorable night of music. Concert footage mixes with home videos of Justin playing drums and showcasing his talent. - Boyz II Men (Documentary)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition. - Vince Vaughn, Christine Taylor, Ben Stiller, Rip Torn, Justin Long (Comedy)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jon Bernthal, Jon Hamm (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Este Haim, Elizabeth Berkley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known. - Dakota Fanning, Kathryn Hunter, Mary McCormack, Rachel Blanchard, Devyn Nekoda (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened. - Christina Ricci, Colleen Camp, Lew Temple, Nick Vallelonga, Santino Barnard (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - Lilly Singh, Sonia Dhillon Tully, Sabrina Jalees, Ana Gasteyer, Stephanie Beatriz (Comedy)

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. - Kristen Stewart, Steven Yeun (Romance, Science fiction, Drama)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet. - Bowen Yang, Lily Gladstone, Kelly Marie Tran, Han Gi-chan, Bobo Le (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Kevin Garnett: Anything Is Possible
programme.desc: Chronicling the career of one of the NBA's all-time greats, featuring scenes from Garnett's induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame. (Special, Documentary, Basketball)

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies. - Demetri Martin, Kevin Kline, Gillian Jacobs, Rory Scovel, Christine Woods (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Just Another Immigrant: Romesh at the Greek
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan, a successful comedian in England, moves his entire family to Los Angeles to make it as a comedian in America; he then takes the drastic step of performing his first ever U.S. stand-up show at the historic Greek Theatre. (Special, Comedy, Standup)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children. - Dave Johns, Hayley Squires, Dylan McKiernan, Briana Shann, Kate Rutter (Drama)

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara, Beverly D'Angelo, Ian Anthony Dale (Drama)

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. - Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Will Poulter, Emma Roberts, Ed Helms (Comedy, Action, Crime drama)

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend. - Rico Verhoeven, Frank Grillo, Roland Møller, Rona-Lee Shim'on, Kevin Janssens (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy.

programme.title: Confess, Fletch

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: When an inmate is granted one weekend of freedom to see her dying mother, a rookie correction officer struggles to keep her under control.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: A journalist (Naomi Watts) investigates the mystery behind a bizarre videotape that brings death after seven days to all who view it.

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

programme.title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: A doomed boy stalls a witch (Deborah Harry) with three tales: "Lot 249," "Cat From Hell" and "Lover's Vow."

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: An airport security agent must figure out how to make the relationship work when a beautiful, successful woman falls in love with him.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. - Ben Affleck, Jennifer Aniston, Drew Barrymore, Jennifer Connelly, Kevin Connolly (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!

programme.desc: What could possibly go wrong when three buddies (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) decide to join the Boy Scouts? programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)
